title: Tensor product of Weil complexes
statement:
Fix $X_0,E$, $X$, $\mathcal C_E=D^b_c(X,E)$ and geometric Frobenius pullback $P=\Phi_X^*$ as in [def-wf-weil-category]. Thus $X_0$ is separated of finite type over $\mathbf F_q$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with $\ell\nmid q$, and $\mathcal C_E$ is the raw rationalization of the compatible uniform integral category. The construction of [def-wf-tensor-product] defines a bifunctor
$$-\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}-:\mathrm{WeilD}(X_0,E)\times\mathrm{WeilD}(X_0,E)\longrightarrow\mathrm{WeilD}(X_0,E).$$
Its underlying object is $K\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}L$, its Frobenius is $(\varphi_K\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}\varphi_L)\circ\mu_{K,L}$ in the notation of that definition, and on commuting morphisms it sends $(u,v)$ to $u\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}v$.

Exactness means the following precise underlying assertion: for every fixed $L\in\mathcal C_E$, the functors $K\mapsto K\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}L$ and $K\mapsto L\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}K$ on $\mathcal C_E$ commute with shifts and carry distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles. Here $\mathcal C_E$ has the triangulation induced from the integral full subcategory [lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated] by raw scalar localization [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated]. This asserts exactness of the underlying tensor functors, without imposing a triangulated structure on the fixed-pair category of [def-wf-weil-category].

proof.text: Put $A=\mathcal O_E$, choose $\varpi$, and put $B=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_X$. In [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] every object of $\mathcal C_E$ has an integral representative in the compatible uniform category. For representatives $M,N$, apply [lem-ag-uniform-complete-tensor] to $X$: the scheme hypotheses are exactly those required in [def-wf-weil-category], whose $\mathcal C_E$ is this rationalization. It gives $\Lambda(M\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}N)$ in the same integral category. By the object and morphism conventions of [def-wf-tensor-product], its rationalization is precisely $K\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}L$. Thus the ambient tensor bifunctor takes $\mathcal C_E\times\mathcal C_E$ into $\mathcal C_E$; this is a restriction on objects, not a change of coefficient models.

source.place: Proof, Frobenius isomorphisms and ambient tensor bifunctor; closure and underlying exactness made explicit

proof.text:
Write $T(K,L)=K\otimes_E^{\mathbf L}L$. The comparison $\mu_{K,L}:PT(K,L)\xrightarrow{\sim}T(PK,PL)$ is the one constructed in [def-wf-tensor-product]. It is natural simultaneously in both variables. Indeed [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] gives naturality of the ordinary comparison on flat-term K-flat models. The coefficient identifications and Koszul tower maps in the definition commute with every map of such models, and the completion unit and completion functor are natural by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. The uniqueness of descent in [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent] extends the equality from K-flat models to derived morphisms. Rationalization extends it to fractions by the definition's bilinear rule. In particular, for $u:K\to K'$ and $v:L\to L'$,
$$\mu_{K',L'}\circ P(T(u,v))=T(Pu,Pv)\circ\mu_{K,L}.$$

source.place: Proof, Frobenius isomorphisms and ambient tensor bifunctor; closure and underlying exactness made explicit

proof.text: For Weil pairs define $\theta_{K,L}=T(\varphi_K,\varphi_L)\circ\mu_{K,L}$, exactly as in [def-wf-tensor-product]. Its inverse is $\mu_{K,L}^{-1}\circ T(\varphi_K^{-1},\varphi_L^{-1})$: both composites are identities by bifunctoriality. With step 1, this is an object of [def-wf-weil-category]. That category asks for one invertible map $PK\to K$; it has no additional independent cocycle datum. Iterates, if desired, are the successive pullbacks and composites of this map, with the recursion determining them.

source.place: Proof, Frobenius isomorphisms and ambient tensor bifunctor; closure and underlying exactness made explicit

proof.text:
Let $u:(K,\varphi_K)\to(K',\varphi_{K'})$ and $v:(L,\varphi_L)\to(L',\varphi_{L'})$ be commuting Weil morphisms. By their defining equations in [def-wf-weil-category], bifunctoriality, and the naturality identity of step 2,
$$\begin{aligned}
T(u,v)\circ\theta_{K,L}
&=T(u\varphi_K,v\varphi_L)\circ\mu_{K,L}\\
&=T(\varphi_{K'}Pu,\varphi_{L'}Pv)\circ\mu_{K,L}\\
&=T(\varphi_{K'},\varphi_{L'})\circ\mu_{K',L'}\circ P(T(u,v))\\
&=\theta_{K',L'}\circ P(T(u,v)).
\end{aligned}$$
Hence $T(u,v)$ is the required Weil morphism. Tensor preserves the pair of identity arrows and the composition of pairs because the ambient operation in [def-wf-tensor-product] is a bifunctor. Equality of Weil morphisms is equality of their underlying arrows. These identities establish the asserted bifunctor and its stated formulas.

source.place: Proof, Frobenius isomorphisms and ambient tensor bifunctor; closure and underlying exactness made explicit

proof.text: For an integral representative $N$, choose a flat-term K-flat model using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. By [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated], ordinary derived tensor with $N$ in either position is exact on $D(B)$, including its shift comparison and connecting maps. Applying [lem-sfb-ringed-complete-triangulated] with the single global section $\varpi$ shows that its composite with the precise Koszul completion $\Lambda$ in [def-wf-tensor-product] is exact. Step 1 gives closure on the compatible uniform full subcategory; its distinguished triangles and shifts are inherited by [lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated]. Therefore the completed tensor restricts to an exact functor on that integral subcategory in each variable. Finally [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated] says that distinguished triangles of the raw rationalization are isomorphic to localized integral distinguished triangles. The tensor sends localized integral arrows by the fraction rule of [def-wf-tensor-product]; hence it sends each such triangle, and every triangle isomorphic to it, to a distinguished triangle. The localized shift comparisons give its commutation with shifts. This proves precisely the stated exactness on $\mathcal C_E$.

lean.statement: theorem wf_tensor_weil : ∃ (T : wfTensorCoefficientCategory D c X₀ E × wfTensorCoefficientCategory D c X₀ E ⥤ wfTensorCoefficientCategory D c X₀ E) (W : WeilD D c X₀ E × WeilD D c X₀ E ⥤ WeilD D c X₀ E), ((wfTensorCoefficientInclusion D c X₀ E).prod (wfTensorCoefficientInclusion D c X₀ E)) ⋙ wfTensor D c X₀ E = T ⋙ wfTensorCoefficientInclusion D c X₀ E ∧ (∀ K L : WeilD D c X₀ E, (W.obj (K, L)).carrier = T.obj (K.carrier, L.carrier) ∧ HEq (wfWeilStructure D c X₀ E (W.obj (K, L))) (wfTensorFrobenius D c X₀ E K L)) ∧ (∀ (K K' L L' : WeilD D c X₀ E) (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'), HEq (W.map (Prod.mkHom f g)).hom.f (T.map (Prod.mkHom f.hom.f g.hom.f))) ∧ (fun [hDim : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim (D.geometricFiber X₀).left ≤ n)] [hInv : Fact (∀ t : (D.geometricFiber X₀).left, IsUnit (c.l : (D.geometricFiber X₀).left.presheaf.stalk t))] ↦ ∀ L : wfTensorCoefficientCategory D c X₀ E, (∃ s : ((Functor.curry.obj T).obj L).CommShift ℤ, (fun [sInst : ((Functor.curry.obj T).obj L).CommShift ℤ] ↦ ((Functor.curry.obj T).obj L).IsTriangulated) (sInst := s)) ∧ (∃ s : ((Functor.curry.obj T).flip.obj L).CommShift ℤ, (fun [sInst : ((Functor.curry.obj T).flip.obj L).CommShift ℤ] ↦ ((Functor.curry.obj T).flip.obj L).IsTriangulated) (sInst := s))) (hDim := ⟨(weilGeometricFiber_coefficientHypotheses D c X₀).2.1⟩) (hInv := ⟨(weilGeometricFiber_coefficientHypotheses D c X₀).2.2⟩)
lean.note: The theorem asserts an actual restriction of the recorded completed ambient tensor to the raw rational constructible category and its Weil fixed pairs.
